ANZ300-081930-
157 AM EST Sun Nov 8 2026

.Synopsis for the Long Island and Connecticut coastal waters...
Low pressure strengthens as it moves northward into the Canadian
Maritimes today. This low remains in Southeast Canada tonight and
eventually weakens Monday. Meanwhile, a series of frontal systems
pass through early into midweek. Stronger and larger low pressure
develops near the vicinity of the local waters towards late in 
the week.
